name: Eliakim (son of Abiud)
title: Link in the genealogy of Jesus
summary: Eliakim is the son of Abiud and the father of Azor in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew. He belongs to the third group of fourteen generations, from the Babylonian exile to Christ, and is known only from this list. He is not the same person as Eliakim son of Hilkiah, the palace administrator under King Hezekiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Matthew names Eliakim as the son of Abiud and the father of Azor.
